user_request: Recommend a bounded first-launch audience for Shiftdeck, including exclusions, reachability, capacity, evidence limits, and the next validation step.

trusted_context.authority: Recommend; do not select accounts or start outreach. Desired learning: whether 20 workspaces can reach repeated value within four weeks. Only 20 onboarding hours are available.

source_records.text: Ten eligible enterprises are reachable through existing relationships. Onboarding requires six hours each; procurement usually takes eight weeks. Eight of ten enterprise pilot teams returned after concierge assistance.
Forty-five eligible small teams opted into product research. Onboarding takes one hour each, with no procurement. Nine of fifteen small-team pilots returned without assistance.
Both segments can use current scheduling features. No prospective launch cohort has yet agreed to participate. Pilot recruitment was purposive, and workflows differed.
